title: Create executable tests with an explicit framework and runner
goal: Create xUnit v3 or NUnit test projects when their package assets, entry point and dotnet test runner must agree.

selectionNotes: Choose the original xUnit v3 MTP-v2 route.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Declared managed consumer target; independent of the installed Playbook host.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: SDK family supplying the newer commands and build tasks; exact RC2 pin is evidence.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Supported language mode of the compiled .NET 11 C# examples.

packages.name: xunit.v3.mtp-v2
packages.reason: The reproducible original xUnit route uses its MTP-v2 executable entry point.

packageAssets: xunit.v3.mtp-v2 executable entry point and Microsoft.Testing.Platform transitive assets.
platforms: SDK-supported platforms; original runner execution measured on Windows x64.
prerequisites: PowerShell 7 for the recorded checks; inspect the selected application's target, global.json and shared build/package settings.
constraints: Playbook serves this guidance offline; the calling agent selects and runs consumer commands.
This edition declares target 11 only. Actual .NET 10 examples are previous-release comparisons, not extra historical foundations or an undeclared compatibility route.
MTP mode and VSTest mode have different selectors and option forwarding. A solution containing incompatible runner projects must be migrated or selected deliberately.
stabilityLimitations: .NET 11 evidence uses RC2, not GA. No API taught here is designated experimental; reconcile final SDK contracts at GA.
